content: How can employees report conduct concerns, and is retaliation allowed?

Employees can report conduct concerns to their direct manager (if the concern does not involve the manager), People & Culture at hr@apexsolutions.internal, or the anonymous reporting line at ethics@apexsolutions.internal. All reports are treated confidentially to the extent possible. Retaliation against an employee for making a good-faith report is itself a violation of the company's policy and will be dealt with seriously.
